name: hcportal_getHcAdminPrivileges
description: Returns the platform-admin privilege flags (HC.PlatformAdmin) of the authenticated caller. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with no context identifier; service accounts (@callerType != 0) are rejected. On success always exactly one row (LEFT JOIN from a one-row base); every flag is 0 when the caller has no live PlatformAdmin row (removed = 0). No kennel gate — this is how the portal decides which platform tools to show.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered portal device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidatePortalAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against device secret via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned alone on auth failure (ValidatePortalAuth message), on service-account rejection ('Service accounts may not call this endpoint'), or from the CATCH (ERROR_MESSAGE(), not logged).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: ValidatePortalAuth message (NVARCHAR(255)), the service-account literal, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH.

rowsets.name: PlatformAdminPrivileges
rowsets.description: On success (callerType = 0): exactly one row. Each flag is COALESCE(PlatformAdmin.<flag>, 0).

columns.name: CanViewMonitor
columns.description: COALESCE(HC.PlatformAdmin.CanViewMonitor, 0). Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. Always 0 when no matching PlatformAdmin row exists.

columns.name: CanManageNewsflash
columns.description: COALESCE(HC.PlatformAdmin.CanManageNewsflash, 0). Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. Always 0 when no matching PlatformAdmin row exists.

columns.name: CanEditKennel
columns.description: COALESCE(HC.PlatformAdmin.CanEditKennel, 0). Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (added via ALTER TABLE migration). Always 0 when no matching PlatformAdmin row exists.

columns.name: CanManagePermissions
columns.description: COALESCE(HC.PlatformAdmin.CanManagePermissions, 0). Column added by db/hc6/portal/archive/migration_add_CanManagePermissions_to_PlatformAdmin.sql (SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0); HC.PlatformAdmin has no file in db/schema/tables.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 54-57: the CATCH returns {Success 0, ErrorMessage} but writes no HC.ErrorLog row, so a failure is invisible server-side.
db/hc6/portal/archive/HC.PlatformAdmin.CreateAndSeed.sql line 13 declares removed BIT NOT NULL; the house rule is SMALLINT. Line 51 compares it to 0, which works by implicit conversion.

breakingChanges: Never remove a column from the PlatformAdminPrivileges rowset — callers read the four flag columns by name.
Never change the guarantee that exactly one row is always returned on success — callers may not handle an empty result set.
Never change the COALESCE-to-0 behaviour — callers rely on 0 meaning 'no privilege' rather than NULL meaning 'unknown'.
Never allow service accounts (@callerType != 0) to call this SP without updating the caller matrix — service accounts should not be querying platform-admin flags.
